instances.overview: The Model is Base Model, Fine Tunable.
instances.usage:
Scenario: Using the same location and depth (latitude 34.05, longitude -118.24, depth 10 km), instead of asking "what exact magnitude," we ask "how risky is this, broadly speaking?"
The model compares this input against historical patterns and assigns it to one of three relative risk tiers Low, Medium, or High based on where similar past events fell in the magnitude distribution of this dataset.
For this example, the model classifies it as Low risk, with roughly 75% confidence, versus 22% Medium and 3% High. This means historically, events at this location/depth combination have mostly stayed below magnitude 3.5.
This tiered output is useful when a simple category (rather than a precise decimal number) is more actionable for example, in a dashboard meant for quick visual scanning rather than detailed scientific analysis.
